meta.title: StudyPal — AI Study Assistant
meta.description: Open-source AI study assistant: chat, flashcards, quizzes and summaries in English or Bahasa Melayu, on any OpenAI-compatible LLM. Bring your own API key.
nav.label: Main
language.label: Language
chat.welcomeBody: Ask anything about your studies. I explain concepts step by step and check your understanding.
chat.suggestion2: Make a 4-week study plan for calculus
chat.inputHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.emptyAnswer: The model sent an empty answer. Please try again.
flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.intro: Turn any topic into a deck you can flip through and mark off as you learn.
flashcards.question: Question
flashcards.tapToFlip: Tap the card to flip it
flashcards.empty: Enter a topic above to generate flashcards.
quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.intro: Five multiple-choice questions, with an explanation after each answer.
quiz.resultExcellent: Excellent! You really know this topic.
quiz.resultGood: Good effort! Review the tricky ones.
quiz.resultKeepGoing: Keep studying. You will get there!
quiz.empty: Enter a topic above to start a quiz.
summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.intro: Paste notes, an article or a textbook section and get a structured study summary.
stats.title: Stats
stats.intro: Token usage reported by your provider in this browser tab. It resets when you reload the page.
stats.streamNote: Chat and summaries are counted only when the provider includes usage in its stream.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose the AI provider StudyPal talks to.
settings.serverIntro: This StudyPal is set up by its owner with a server-side key, so you do not need your own.
settings.customEndpointHint: Any OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1. Enabled by this server's owner.
settings.privacy: Your key is saved only in this browser. It is sent with each request through this app's server to {provider}, and the server never stores or logs it. Prefer a key with a spending limit, and press {forget} on shared devices.
settings.storageBlocked: Your browser blocked local storage, so the key only lasts until you close this tab.
settings.errorModel: That model name has characters a model id cannot contain.
settings.errorKey: Paste your {provider} API key to continue.
settings.errorLocal: {provider} only works when you self-host StudyPal.
notice.byok: StudyPal runs on {own} here (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq and more). It stays in your browser and is never stored on the server.
error.missing_key: Add your API key in Settings to use StudyPal.
error.invalid_key_format: That does not look like an API key. Paste it again in Settings.
error.unknown_provider: Unknown provider. Pick one from the list in Settings.
error.provider_not_allowed: That provider runs on your own computer, so this hosted app cannot reach it. Self-host StudyPal to use it.
error.base_url_not_allowed: Custom endpoints are disabled on this server. Pick one of the listed providers.
error.invalid_base_url: The custom endpoint must be an http(s) URL.
error.invalid_model: That model name has characters a model id cannot contain.
error.bad_request: StudyPal could not use that request. Check what you entered and try again.
error.server_misconfigured: This server has an unknown LLM_PROVIDER configured. Ask the site owner to fix it.
error.invalid_key: The provider rejected your key. Check that it is correct and still active.
error.forbidden: The provider refused the request. Your key may not have access to this model.
error.model_not_found: The provider could not find that model. Check the model name in Settings.
error.rate_limited: The provider says you hit a rate limit or ran out of credit. Wait a moment or check your plan.
error.upstream_bad_request: The provider rejected the request. The model name may be wrong or unsupported.
error.upstream_unavailable: The provider is having trouble right now. Please try again shortly.
error.upstream_unreachable: Could not reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.
error.upstream_timeout: The provider took too long to answer. Please try again.
error.unparseable_output: The model's answer was not in the expected format. Try again or pick a stronger model.
error.network: Could not reach StudyPal. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
